summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the closing of Viking Acquisition Corp. II's initial public offering (IPO) and simultaneous private placement. On July 6, 2026, the SPAC issued 23,000,000 Units at $10.00 each, raising $230M in gross proceeds, and sold 610,000 private placement units at $10.00 each for $6.1M. Each Unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a warrant exercisable at $11.50. This is a routine capital-raising event for a blank-check company, not a special situation. No business combination, tender offer, or other special-situation event is being announced.
